# External links, 2026-10-29

Outbound access limitation: all 7,112 URL checks remain unverified. Node fetch reported cancelled requests; a separate representative curl request to erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu returned CONNECT HTTP 403 (raw/external-policy-check.log). Do not interpret these failures as broken destination pages.

Manual built-site audit: HEAD, GET fallback, 8-second timeout, six workers, redirects followed. URL fragments are removed and duplicate URLs share their source-page list. Proxy/policy denials and transport failures are unverified links, not broken-source findings. Once a host is explicitly denied, remaining URLs on that host are recorded as not requested. Full page lists are in links.json. Run NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 npm run check:links after a clean build. This command is outside CI/build.
